title: Lapse of a Live Pet Health Guarantee at the End of Its Period
content:
A Live Pet Health Guarantee with no claim lapses the day after its guarantee period has passed. Nothing is refunded on lapse, and the coverage value ends. The guarantee then shows the status expired, with the date it closed.

## How the lapse date falls

The guarantee period is the number of calendar days after purchase set for the guarantee type, counted from the purchase date as day 0. The last covered day is the day that many days after the purchase date; the guarantee lapses on the following day.

| Hypothetical guarantee | Purchase date | Guarantee period | Last covered day | Lapses on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Type with a 30-day period | 1 March | 30 days | 31 March | 1 April |
| Type with a 14-day period | 3 May | 14 days | 17 May | 18 May |
| Type with a 7-day period | 10 June | 7 days | 17 June | 18 June |

## Points of judgement

- **Only an unclaimed guarantee lapses.** The lapse rule applies to a guarantee with no claim. A guarantee on which a claim has been settled shows the status claimed and does not move to expired.
- **Nothing comes back on lapse.** Lapse brings no refund, credit or other remedy, and whatever covered value the guarantee still showed ends with it.
- **Status after lapse.** An expired guarantee is no longer active.
